name: Camp Sunrise Lake
description_short: County park day camp at the Sunrise Lake Beach Club in Lewis Morris County Park for ages 5 to 11, 9 to 3:30. Half of each day is at the lake swimming, on the inflatable course and slides; the rest is sports, games and crafts.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Camp Sunrise Lake 2026: ages 5 to 11 (CITs 12 to 14 who were campers), 9 to 3:30, four weeks July 6 to 31, all marked sold out. $340 per week before March 1, $355 from March 1 (price_per_week is the regular rate). Morning Explorers early drop off from 8:15 and Afternoon Explorers to 4, $35 per week each. One price for all; no resident rate shown. Location: Sunrise Lake Beach Club at Lewis Morris County Park, 270 Mendham Road, Morris Township.

source.title: 2026 Summer Camps - Morris County Park Commission

for_andrew: The Park Commission page lists about 25 short camps at seven parks (Great Swamp and Pyramid Mountain nature camps, Frelinghuysen Arboretum gardening camps, Fosterfields farm camps, Cooper Gristmill apprentice camps, Central Park and Lewis Morris adventurers, Mennen skating and hockey). Each has its own dates, ages and place. I drafted only Camp Sunrise Lake, the one full multi week day camp; the others could be added as separate listings if wanted.
